changeinfo.changes:
• New netcode options added
  • Fixed swap of Portuguese and Spanish game text
  • Improved randomisation of stage and CPU opponents
  • Enabling How to Play no longer disqualifies you from the Rankings
  • Team rosters now appear on Rankings
  • Added unlockable ending cutscenes to Gallery (view Trophies to unlock cutscenes you earned before this Patch)
  • Added "Top" and "Me" buttons to Rankings
  • Removed black bars on left and right margins of game
  • When someone joins your hosted session, a sound is now made
